# v0.1.0 — Portfolio implementation baseline

First tagged release. Implements the full GlobalPay Bridge engineering pack (foundation → R3) from
`GlobalPay_Bridge_PRD_v1.0.pdf`: an Azure-native, multi-tenant workforce and payroll integration
platform that turns approved time and compensation inputs into controlled payroll runs, idempotent
payment instructions, verified webhook updates and reconciliation results.

## Highlights

- **Clean Architecture, enforced not documented.** Domain → Application → Infrastructure → hosts, with
  architecture tests that fail the build on boundary violations.
- **Multi-tenant by construction.** Request-scoped tenant context, EF Core global query filters bound to
  the context instance, and a cross-tenant test suite that proves isolation.
- **Deterministic payroll.** Configurable gross-to-net rules, versioned immutable snapshots, and a
  maker-checker approval workflow where the creator cannot approve their own run.
- **Reliable integration.** Transactional outbox with leased dispatch and bounded backoff, HMAC-verified
  webhooks with inbox deduplication, and idempotent payment submission keyed by
  `(TenantId, OperationCode, IdempotencyKey)`.
- **Runs anywhere.** One `docker compose up` brings up API, Functions, SQL Server, Redis, Azurite,
  Keycloak and a payment provider simulator; Azure parity is expressed in Bicep.
- **Demonstrated end to end.** An 18-step Swagger UI walkthrough captured as animated GIFs, driven by
  headless Chromium with assertions taken from the real HTTP responses.

## Verification

- Release build: **0 warnings** (analyzers and code style enforced as errors).
- **115 tests pass** — 84 unit, 24 integration, 7 architecture.
- The walkthrough exercises the complete flow against the Docker profile, including the asynchronous
  import and outbox dispatch paths, and asserts the payroll totals (gross 760, deductions 76, net 684
  for 2 workers).

## Contents

- `src/` — Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Contracts, Api, Functions, ProviderSimulator
- `tests/` — unit, integration and architecture suites
- `database/` — guarded create-database script, five reviewed stored procedures
- `infrastructure/` — Bicep modules, per-environment parameters, Keycloak realm
- `docs/` — developer guide, Visual Studio guide, walkthrough gallery, ADRs, requirements and
  traceability, runbooks
- `.github/workflows/` — CI, OIDC deployment, OpenAPI breaking-change diff, dependency scanning

## Getting started

```powershell
docker compose up -d --build
dotnet tool restore
dotnet dotnet-ef database update --project src/GlobalPay.Infrastructure --startup-project src/GlobalPay.Infrastructure
```

Then open <http://localhost:5080/swagger>. See the
[developer guide](https://github.com/i4ba1/globalpay-bridge/blob/main/docs/development/developer-guide.md)
and the [walkthrough gallery](https://github.com/i4ba1/globalpay-bridge/blob/main/docs/walkthrough/README.md).

## Known limitations

- Payslip/summary export (PR-11) and automated outbox replay (PR-12) exist as ports and documented
  procedures; endpoints and tests are not yet written.
- Coverage gates (NFR-08) are not enforced in CI.
- The Bicep templates are syntax-validated but have not been deployed to a subscription.
- Payroll tax logic is deliberately non-statutory and configurable; this project never moves real funds.
